name: Colorful Heart ~12 ko no Kyururun♪~
original_name: カラフルハート ～12コのきゅるるん♪～
source:
Main character 's parents go overseas living him alone. With the help of the childhood friend he becomes accustomed to such life. On the day of graduation ceremony he learns that he needs to marry a woman. 12 bride candidates move in to his house to live together for one month.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的父母前往海外，留下他獨自生活。在青梅竹馬的幫助下，他漸漸習慣一個人生活。畢業典禮當天，他得知自己必須結婚。12名新娘候選人搬進他家，與他共同生活1個月。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
